adventuringGear.name: Backpack
adventuringGear.description: Holds 30 pounds or 1 cubic foot of gear.

adventuringGear.name: Bedroll
adventuringGear.description: A portable sleeping mat.

adventuringGear.name: Crowbar
adventuringGear.description: Using a crowbar grants Advantage on Strength checks where leverage can be applied.

adventuringGear.name: Grappling Hook
adventuringGear.description: A hook for climbing.

adventuringGear.name: Hammer
adventuringGear.description: A standard hammer.

adventuringGear.name: Healer's Kit
adventuringGear.description: This kit has 10 uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one use to stabilize a creature that has 0 Hit Points.

adventuringGear.name: Holy Symbol
adventuringGear.description: A divine focus for spellcasting.

adventuringGear.name: Hooded Lantern
adventuringGear.description: Casts Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

adventuringGear.name: Oil (flask)
adventuringGear.description: As a Utilize action, you can splash oil on a creature within 5 feet or throw it up to 20 feet.

adventuringGear.name: Rations (1 day)
adventuringGear.description: Dried food suitable for travel.

adventuringGear.name: Rope, Hempen (50 feet)
adventuringGear.description: Has 2 Hit Points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

adventuringGear.name: Rope, Silk (50 feet)
adventuringGear.description: Has 2 Hit Points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

adventuringGear.name: Thieves' Tools
adventuringGear.description: A set of picks and tools for disabling locks and traps.

adventuringGear.name: Tinderbox
adventuringGear.description: Using a tinderbox to light a torch—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a Utilize action.

adventuringGear.name: Torch
adventuringGear.description: A torch burns for 1 hour, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

adventuringGear.name: Waterskin
adventuringGear.description: Holds 4 pints of liquid.

adventuringGear.name: Component Pouch
adventuringGear.description: Holds material components for spellcasting.

adventuringGear.name: Arcane Focus
adventuringGear.description: An arcane focus for spellcasting.

adventuringGear.name: Druidic Focus
adventuringGear.description: A druidic focus for spellcasting.

adventuringGear.name: Spellbook
adventuringGear.description: A book used by wizards to record spells.

magicItems.name: Bead of Nourishment
magicItems.description: This spongy, flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves in liquid. If consumed, it provides as much nourishment as 1 day of rations.

magicItems.name: Cloak of Invisibility
magicItems.description: While wearing this cloak, you can pull its hood over your head to make yourself Invisible. While you are Invisible, anything you carry or wear is also Invisible. You become visible when you cease wearing the hood or take a Hostile action.

magicItems.name: Elixir of Health
magicItems.description: When you drink this elixir, it cures any disease afflicting you, and it removes the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned conditions. The clear red liquid has tiny bubbles of light in it.

magicItems.name: Energy Bow
magicItems.description: This magic weapon functions as a Shortbow or Longbow. When you pull back its string, an arrow of pure energy forms. When you hit with an attack roll using this bow, the target takes an extra 1d6 Force damage.

magicItems.name: Gloves of Thievery
magicItems.description: These gloves are invisible while worn. While wearing them, you have a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Dexterity checks made to pick locks.

magicItems.name: Hat of Many Spells
magicItems.description: This hat has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge as a Magic action to pull a random spell scroll from it. Roll 1d6 to determine the spell scroll's level (1-2: level 1, 3-4: level 2, 5-6: level 3). The hat regains all expended charges daily at dawn.

magicItems.name: Potion of Invulnerability
magicItems.description: For 1 minute after you drink this potion, you have Resistance to all damage. The potion's syrupy liquid looks like liquified iron.

magicItems.name: Potion of Longevity
magicItems.description: When you drink this potion, your physical age is reduced by 1d6 + 6 years, to a minimum of 13 years. Each time you subsequently drink a Potion of Longevity, there is a cumulative 10 percent chance that you instead age by 1d6 + 6 years.

magicItems.name: Potion of Vitality
magicItems.description: When you drink this potion, it removes any Exhaustion you are suffering and cures any disease or poison affecting you. For the next 24 hours, you regain the maximum number of Hit Points for any Hit Point Die you spend.

magicItems.name: Quarterstaff of the Acrobat
magicItems.description: While holding this magic quarterstaff, you have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While wielding the staff, you can use a Bonus Action to make one additional attack with it, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

magicItems.name: Rod of Resurrection
magicItems.description: The rod has 5 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Heal or 5 charges to cast Resurrection from it. The rod regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn.

magicItems.name: Sending Stones
magicItems.description: These smooth stones come in pairs, with each one etched with a small symbol linking it to its partner. While you touch one stone, you can cast Sending from it, targeting the bearer of the other stone. Once Sending is cast through the stones, they can't be used again until the next dawn.

magicItems.name: Sentinel Shield
magicItems.description: While holding this shield, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks. The shield is emblazoned with a symbol of an eye.

magicItems.name: Shield of the Cavalier
magicItems.description: While holding this shield, you have a +2 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC. While mounted and holding this shield, your mount has a +2 bonus to AC.

magicItems.name: Thunderous Greatclub
magicItems.description: You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit with an attack roll using this greatclub, the target takes an extra 2d6 Thunder damage, and each creature of your choice within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Thunder damage.

magicItems.name: Mysterious Deck
magicItems.description: Usually found in a box or pouch, this deck contains a number of cards made of ivory or vellum. Most (75 percent) of these decks have only thirteen cards, but the rest have twenty-two. Before you draw a card, you must declare how many cards you intend to draw and then draw them randomly.

magicItems.name: Dragon Orb
magicItems.description: Ages past, elves and humans waged a terrible war against evil dragons. When the world seemed doomed, powerful wizards came together and worked their greatest magic, producing five Dragon Orbs to help them defeat the dragons.
